description: This file contains a test specification for skipping browser downloads during installation of Playwright, part of the test suite for Playwright's installation process.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case for skipping browser downloads during Playwright installation.

ctags.name: output
ctags.pattern: /^    const output = await exec('node inspector-custom-executable.js', { env: { PWDEBUG: '1' } });$/

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^  const result = await exec('npm i --foreground-scripts playwright @playwright\/browser-firefox'/
